visualCharacteristics.structure: store name + address + phone + opening hours
visualCharacteristics.notes: 4/8 grid: left column with Use My Location, search input and scrollable collapsible store list (bordered rows, chevron); right column map panel (Google Maps embed of the selected store's address + directions link)

contentPattern: Accordion (2-3 columns per row): cell 1 = store name (numbering generated by JS unless authored); cell 2 = 'Address: ...' paragraph, 'Phone: <tel link>' paragraph (optional), 'Opening time' list of day/hours; optional cell 3 = 'lat,lng' used for Use My Location distance sorting and precise map pins. ~120 rows.
